Interface GamePhase

All Known Implementing Classes:
EndGamePhase, EndTurnPhase, PlaceTotemPhase, PlayerOfferPhase, WaitingForPlayersPhase
public interface GamePhase
Defines the contract for the State pattern managing the game's lifecycle.

This interface represents a discrete phase (state) of the game. It declares all possible player actions as default methods that automatically throw an InvalidActionException. Concrete phase implementations will override only the specific actions that are legally allowed during that particular state, enforcing the game rules dynamically and avoiding massive conditional blocks in the main Game class.

    • fromSnapshot

      static GamePhase fromSnapshot(PhaseSnapshot snapshot, List<Player> players, int numPlayers)
      Reconstructs the exact game phase from a previously saved snapshot.

      This static factory method acts as the state deserializer. It identifies the correct concrete phase type from the snapshot's name and properly relinks any required Player instances using their nicknames.

      Note: Transient phases like END_TURN or END_GAME cannot be directly restored from a snapshot, as they are immediate resolution states.

      Parameters:
      snapshot - the serialized phase state
      players - the list of currently active players in the game to be relinked
      numPlayers - the total number of players configured for the game
      Returns:
      the fully reconstructed concrete GamePhase
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the phase is transient or unknown
